responsibility: Implements the IPA pass that localizes private symbols into COMDAT groups when their uses are proven confined to a single group. It performs a small lattice/dataflow analysis over references, callers, aliases, inline clones, and thunks to determine an exclusive owning COMDAT group, then rewrites same-group membership for eligible functions or variables. Its role is to reduce dead retained code from separately replaceable COMDAT copies rather than to manage general visibility or partitioning.
